# 苏德昭 / Dezhao Su

> 苏德昭的官方个人学术主页。Dezhao Su's official academic homepage.

Canonical homepage: https://sudezhao2002.github.io/
English version: https://sudezhao2002.github.io/en.html

## Identity

- Chinese name: 苏德昭
- English name: Dezhao Su
- Current role: Ph.D. student in Electronic Information at Fudan University
- Joint training: Fudan University and TeleAI
- Laboratory: Intelligent Complex Systems Laboratory at Fudan University
- Bachelor's degree: Communication Engineering, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

## Research interests

- Embodied agents
- Self-evolving agents
- Vision-language models
- Multimodal retrieval

## Selected publications

- ReSA: Preserving Reference-Specified Foreground in In-Context Segmentation. arXiv preprint, 2026. Dezhao Su is the first and corresponding author. Authors: Dezhao Su, Bingxu Hou, Jingdi Lei, Lin Qian, Likai Wang, Yunyun Wan.
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27341

- From Tasks to Turns: Measuring Human Labor Contributions in Human–Agent Joint Production. arXiv preprint, 2026. Likai Wang and Dezhao Su are co-first authors; Dezhao Su is listed second.
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26365

- SELC: Synergistic Text-Motion Enhancement and Latent Constraint Modeling for Text-to-Motion Generation. IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM), 2026. Dezhao Su is the third author.
- Paper: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11737585

- V-Retrver: Evidence-Driven Agentic Reasoning for Universal Multimodal Retrieval. EMNLP 2026. Dongyang Chen and Chaoyang Wang are co-first authors; Dezhao Su is listed immediately after them.
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06034
- Code: https://github.com/chendy25/V-Retrver
